_help: Act 2, the museum: recruiting Dr. Arthur Pembroke (hired_pembroke). 70, or 50 if you researched the archive first (researched_akmentar). Turning him down tells you about Hassan (knows_hassan). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

already.speaker: pembroke
already.line: My equipment is crated and labelled. Every crate. I trust yours is too.

first.speaker: pembroke
first.line: Dr. Arthur Pembroke. I gather you want a scholar to lend your treasure hunt some respectability.

choices.label: Offer him the job
choices.line: I want a real archaeologist. Someone who does it properly.

choices.label: Ask about his last dig
choices.line: They say your last expedition went badly.

failure.speaker: pembroke
failure.line: Wadi Natrun, 1919. Bad funding, worse records. Half the finds vanished before they were catalogued, and my name went with them. I will not make that mistake twice.

terms.speaker: pembroke
terms.line: Seventy pounds, in advance. Every find recorded and catalogued before anyone touches it, and nothing leaves the site unregistered.

choices.label: Agree to everything
choices.line: Seventy pounds, and every find on paper. Done.

choices.label: Show him the archive papers
choices.line: I've been through the museum's own Akmentar boxes. This isn't a fairy tale, Doctor.

choices.label: Haggle
choices.line: Seventy is steep for a man who needs this more than I do.

homework.speaker: pembroke
homework.line: You've actually read them. Well. That changes the odds a little. Fifty pounds, and the records are mine to keep.

haggle.speaker: pembroke
haggle.line: I am not a porter to be haggled with. Seventy, or find yourself a cheaper conscience.

broke.speaker: pembroke
broke.line: Then you can't afford me. If you want a scholar who works for legends, try Dr. Hassan al-Masri in the old quarter. The museum dismissed him for less than this.

joined.speaker: pembroke
joined.line: Very well. I shall want a proper camera, and someone who can hold it still.
